list-max-height.$description: Combobox's own floating list — the most height it takes before it scrolls. The list is also limited to the room left on the screen, so this only decides how tall a long list is allowed to get on a large one; no spacing step is large enough to name it.

xs.$description: The fixed height of a one-line option row at this size step. A long list draws only the rows in view, which needs every row's height known without measuring it, so the height is a token rather than the sum of padding and line height. Never below 1.5rem (WCAG 2.5.8) at any step.

xs.$description: The fixed height of an option row that also shows a description line, at this size step: the one-line height plus a second, smaller line. Rows with and without a description are the two heights a long list is drawn from.
